score_basis: Subjective scoped engineering assessment; overall estimate inherited. Neither is a weighted Chromium-parity metric.
decision: Accept bounded correctness-preserving reduction in unnecessary allocations and parsing; do not claim a proven workload-wide speed gain.
changes: Unnamed resolved Grid tracks serialize cached actual sizes without allocating line-name buffers or reparsing track declarations. Named-track, computed fallback, pseudo and animation behavior remain on existing paths.

performance.interpretation: Ranges overlap and unrelated phases changed; no isolated causal attribution. The large historical slowdown versus128 is not resolved.

resource_monitoring.caveat: Process snapshots may miss short-lived children; summed RSS can double-count shared pages.

next: Actual frozen-engine V8 sampling before a bounded pure-grammar cache; dataURL candidate152 independently validated in parallel.
